summary.summary: Hi, I joined the GenAI team last week and still don't have an API key for the internal LLM platform. Our proof-of-concept demo to the business is on Friday, can this be sped up?

suggested_resolution.answer: No, the process cannot be expedited as it requires approval from the project lead and issuance by the AI Platform Team within 2 business days [1]. You should raise an "AI Platform Access" request immediately if you haven't done so already.

sources.text:
DEV-001: Internal GenAI Platform Access and API Keys (synthetic analogue) > Requesting an API Key
1. Raise an "AI Platform Access" request with the project ID from the AI use-case register.
2. The project lead approves the request.
3. The AI Platform Team issues the dev key within 2 business days. Test and prod keys additionally need a completed AI risk assessment.
4. Keys are stored in the team's secrets vault. Never put keys in source code, tickets, chat or email.

DEV-001: Internal GenAI Platform Access and API Keys (synthetic analogue) > Who Can Get Access
- Engineers in an approved GenAI project. The project must be registered in the AI use-case register before keys are issued.
- Each project gets one API key per environment (dev, test, prod). Personal keys are not issued.

DEV-001: Internal GenAI Platform Access and API Keys (synthetic analogue) > Overview
Owner: AI Platform Team | Applies to: engineers building GenAI features

DEV-001: Internal GenAI Platform Access and API Keys (synthetic analogue) > Data Rules
Only data classified Public or Internal may be sent to the platform in dev. Confidential data needs an approved prod setup with logging disabled for prompts.

draft_reply:
Thank you for reaching out regarding your API key for the internal LLM platform. I understand the urgency, and your ticket has been assigned to the Technical & IT Support team with a priority level of P2.

To expedite the process, please ensure you have raised an "AI Platform Access" request immediately if you haven't done so already. Additionally, I recommend following up with your project lead for approval.

The AI Platform Team will process your request within 2 business days. If you need further assistance, feel free to reach out.
